_comment_encoding: Output is dimmer2048 (binary, 0x000-0x800), not the dimmer800 (BCD 0-800) the file name says: the Spartan-7 bitstream multiplies register 0x35 as plain binary and has never decoded BCD, so BCD made the backlight a staircase with ~5.5 % jumps at every BCD hundreds boundary (12.5, 25, ... 100 %). Measured 2026-10-11: binary is linear, ~12 nits per 1 %. The file keeps its name because micropanel's pi-config-txt links it by name.
_comment_variant: 14.6-inch FHD direct-drive panel (pi-config-txt type 14.6-fhd). Same Spartan-7 board, OPT4001 and dimmer800 output as config_fpga_opti4001_lux_dimmer800.json (12.3-NQ5, which keeps the shared dimmer800.csv) and config_fpga_opti4001_lux_dimmer800_14_6_ej.json (scan-mode EJ); only the brightness-to-nits curve differs, so only sweep_table does. calibrations/dimmer800_14_6_dd.csv is a REFERENCE (golden-sample) sweep of one direct-drive unit, 2026-10-11.

local_dimming_profiles._comment: Day/night local dimming (pixelpipe-fpga docs/dynamic-local-dimming.md step 3; FPGA v0x56+). The detected zone selects raw FPGA 0x1E page-0 registers: ld_alpha 0x31 (LD max/avg blend, 16 = baked default; higher = small content brighter, more halo), pc_tune 0x33 (pixel-compensation gain/64, 64 = 1.0x), bl_boost 0x49 (low-APL boost on the LED gain, 64 = off, 90 = up to 2x GD), led_gain 0x43, bl_rise 0x4A. A zone must hold min_dwell_sec before its profile is used; registers then ramp by transition_steps per 500 ms iteration (bl_boost 0 = at once: FPGA v0x57 glides a lowered boost itself). static_profile is used when the user switches dynamic LD off (set_ld_dynamic). Night: no extra brightness for dark content. Outdoor: maximum readability.

thermal_compensation._comment: Only the temperature source is used here (no factor table): the thermal_limit below reads the backlight temperature from the display IOC (0x66, register 0x1002, int16 x 0.1 C).

thermal_limit._comment: Keeps the backlight at or below start_c: at each 10 s reading at/above start_c the LD boost goes off and the brightness limit drops by step_percent (floor min_percent); at/below start_c - hysteresis_c it recovers by step_percent. No reading = no limiting.
